incident-bot: INCIDENT (P2) — Usage-count pipeline anomaly detected. Ledger vs emitter delta > 8% for US region; multiple overage flags triggered. Paging oncall.
Luca (oncall): I'm on it, joining. Any customer-facing alerts? @Alex
Alex (customer-ops): We've got 3 customers with overage emails queued, notice from billing queue. No refunds yet. Holding until root cause.
Priya (billing): Saw a spike in token counts aggregated at the billing joiner. Investigating whether duplicate emit from proxy retries. CorrelationID: 0x8f2a
Maya (sre): Can you paste the emitter logs? I'm checking ingress latencies and any replay from emitter service.
Priya (billing): snippet:
```
2026-03-18T01:12:03Z emitter-service INFO emitted tokens=4823 req_id=abc123 retry=0
2026-03-18T01:12:03Z emitter-service INFO emitted tokens=9646 req_id=abc123 retry=1
```
Maya (sre): OK that's duplicate emission on retry path. Probable cause: ack-loss between proxy and emitter. Nimai, can you validate proxy -> emitter acks?
Nimai (infra): Tracing shows intermittent ACK timeout to kafka partition 12. Restarted emitter consumer on i-3c4; logs show consumer lag dropping. Applying temporary rate-limit on proxy retries: `RETRY_MAX=2`
Luca (oncall): Taking action: 1) drop duplicate pre-ingest (apply dedupe by req_id) 2) kick off backfill scrub job to remove duplicates between 01:10-01:20 3) hold outbound overage emails until scrub finishes.
Priya (billing): Running backfill scrub: `scripts/scrub_duplicates --start=2026-03-18T01:10 --end=2026-03-18T01:20 --id_field=req_id` ETA ~8m. Will report counts.
Alex (customer-ops): Notifying affected accounts we're investigating; will pause overage emails. Template drafted.
Priya (billing): Backfill finished: removed 9,412 duplicated token entries. Net billing delta: -0.97% across cohort. Patching billing ledger to re-sync now.
Maya (sre): Mitigation in prod: dedupe at ingress and proxy retry cap deployed. Monitoring acks/lag for 30m. No further duplicate spikes since deploy :thumbsup:
Luca (oncall): Closing page in 30m if stable. Final customer impact: temporary overage emails queued (3 accounts), actual billing delta negligible after scrub. Action items: postmortem + add alert for duplicate-emission-rate >0.5%.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — mitigations applied, followup required: #postmortems and assign to Priya/Maya/Nimai.
